features.feature: A rebuild preserves the host executable contract before old-dist eviction: POSIX bin targets gain executable access while Windows keeps the byte-identical Node entrypoint used by npm command shims.

Missing or syntactically invalid package manifests, missing bin fields, and genuinely absent targets are benign; other manifest read, stat, realpath, or chmod failures propagate before the working dist is replaced.
Promotion rejects non-files plus final and intermediate symlink escapes, including an escaped parent whose final target is absent, and preserves the existing dist whenever staging validation fails.
Both build wrappers route through the shared promoteDist boundary, and the committed regression checks that wiring and staging-before-eviction ordering.
The committed red regression emits stable GREEN and contract selectors on the repaired candidate, remains discriminating against the unfixed baseline, and is registered in validation configuration.

The real validation_plan command exposes the registered regression by stable id and label; the corrected executable-plus-argv command prints selector red-global-cli-exec-bit [B-e256 global CLI rebuild and promotion regression].

Doctor emits the healthy marker only when the installed global package, PATH-selected command, declared bin target, compiled version, canonical main location, and host executable contract agree; package presence alone cannot substitute for PATH presence.
Doctor resolves the declared bin target and rejects final or intermediate escapes outside the canonical package dist tree, preserving errno evidence for failed probes.

On POSIX doctor requires the PATH-selected command to resolve to the declared target, validates executable access, and renders safely quoted remediation; mode is an observed fact rather than a universal cross-platform promise.

On Windows doctor follows PATHEXT selection, validates an actually executing npm command-shim segment, and renders encoded PowerShell LiteralPath remediation preserving spaces, apostrophes, and percent tokens without relying on POSIX mode bits.
Failure to discover canonical main from a disposable Story worktree remains non-pass and produces topology diagnosis rather than certifying the worktree as the global target.
Capability skips and zero-assertion paths cannot emit the must PASS selector, while non-link Windows assertions still execute.
Mode restoration does not alter byte-content binding semantics, so a later build may still take the content-bound fast path.

Commit 3144360a65 changes exactly six implementation, test, and configuration files, all already declared by the versioned scope contract; the validation planner smoke change is the scoped mechanical proof for CHK-002 discoverability and no unrelated path expansion is present.
Do not alter Codex adapter entrypoint authority, npm link or global-install mechanics, or protected build-lock/crash-safety design; doctor remains read-only and only reports remediation.
